full_judgment: 8. The case of the respondent Nos-2-6 are that the petitioner had filed Title Suit No. 213 of 2001 for declaration of title to the land in question, which is a subject-matter of the instant writ petition. In the Title Suit, the Government, as defendant No. 6, filed written statement stating inter-alia that petitioner along with another took lease of 3.39 acres of land vide VP lease record No. 3/66-67 and 5/67-68 and he was in possession of the suit land on the basis of lease but, it was not renewed. Respondent Nos. 2-6, as defendants, contested the suit, contending inter-alia that admittedly, Ananda Sundary was the owner of the suit land and she transferred 1.92 acres of land in favour of Gopendra Narayan Das and Robindra Narayan Das by way of Will. Subsequently, the record was prepared in the name of Gopendra Narayan Das who died leaving the respondents as his heirs and successors. They transferred 1.44 acres of land in favor of Shafayetul Karim, respondent No. 7 of the suit. Shafayetul Karim, as plaintiff, filed Title Suit No. 14 of 2004 against the petitioner for declaration of title to the land in question and recovery of khas possession, supporting the case of his vendor's i.e. respondent Nos. 2-6.
